segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the cream stays moist and sticky without drying in, and did not work for her, prompting a return.
segments.dry: Reviewers note the formula suits dry skin, with one recommending it specifically for dry skin and another describing plump, hydrated, supple results.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports no irritation and visible improvement in post-acne marks, while another reports the cream and matching sleeping mask made her face feel uncomfortably hot.
segments.mature: No dedicated mature-skin feedback beyond general anti-aging/dark-spot comments is present in this set.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention smoother, plumper, glass-skin-like results but do not specifically frame these as anti-aging effects.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe strong hydration with plump, bouncy, supple skin; a couple find it not lightweight enough or too heavy for their liking despite the added moisture.
concerns.redness: One reviewer credits the product with reducing redness and giving a dewy finish.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer warns generally that layering multiple similar capsule-cream actives could compromise the skin barrier, though this is presented as a caution rather than a personal reaction.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report visible fading of dark spots and hyperpigmentation within weeks; one darker-skinned reviewer highlights a forehead dark spot disappearing with no purging or irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Most report no new breakouts and even reduced post-acne inflammation, but two reviewers describe new whiteheads, milia, or breakouts appearing within days of use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin found the product left a moist, sticky film rather than absorbing, making it unsuitable for her skin type.
